# All results {#sec-results}

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source("R/book.R")
all_results <- list.files("results", pattern = "^ch.*csv$", full.names = TRUE) |>
  map(\(f) read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = cols(note = col_character()))) |>
  list_rbind()
```

## Verdicts by chapter

```{r}
#| label: summary
#| echo: false
all_results |>
  count(Chapter = chapter, verdict) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = verdict, values_from = n, values_fill = 0L) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Rows that failed

```{r}
#| label: failures
#| echo: false
all_results |>
  filter(verdict == "FAIL") |>
  transmute(
    Chapter = chapter, Item = item, Unit = unit, Baseline = baseline,
    `Baseline value` = format_4(baseline_value), RiemannFinMath = format_4(riemann_value), Difference = format_4(difference)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Largest passing difference by chapter

The tables show 4 decimals, so this is the one place with more digits. It shows how far inside the tolerance each chapter is.

```{r}
#| label: largest
#| echo: false
all_results |>
  filter(verdict == "PASS") |>
  summarise(`Largest absolute difference` = formatC(max(abs(difference)), format = "e", digits = 2), .by = chapter) |>
  rename(Chapter = chapter) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Rows without a verdict

```{r}
#| label: not-comparable
#| echo: false
all_results |>
  filter(verdict == "N/C") |>
  transmute(
    Chapter = chapter, Item = item, Unit = unit, Baseline = baseline,
    `Baseline value` = format_4(baseline_value), RiemannFinMath = format_4(riemann_value), Reason = note
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Every row

```{r}
#| label: every-row
#| echo: false
all_results |>
  transmute(
    Chapter = chapter, Item = item, Unit = unit, Baseline = baseline,
    `Baseline value` = format_4(baseline_value), RiemannFinMath = format_4(riemann_value),
    Difference = format_4(difference), Tolerance = format_4(tolerance), Verdict = verdict
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
